## Technical Guides & Real-Data Benchmarks (2026)

- [How to Decode Opaque news.google.com/rss CBMi Links Into Real Publisher URLs & Clean Markdown for AI RAG (2026)](https://truonggiang0111.github.io/mcp/google-news-rss-url-decoder/): 4-stage `DotsSplashUi` `Fbv4je` RPC resolution (`20/20` real publisher URLs decoded in `6.47s`, `15/20` clean full text, `$0` proxy).
- [Mining 1-Star & 2-Star App, Extension & SaaS Reviews for B2B Churn Leads](https://truonggiang0111.github.io/mcp/shopify-app-store-1-star-churn-teardown/): Verified cloud benchmarks across Shopify App Store (`2.7s`, Klaviyo `3,485` reviews + `20` `1★–2★` churn reviews), iOS/Play (`3.02s`, `60` Spotify reviews), VS Code + Open-VSX (`anthropic.claude-code` `100.1M` installs + `121` bug reviews), and Chrome Web Store (`4.70s`, `15/15` dev emails).
- [Filtering Out Recruitment Agency & Bootcamp Spam (~48% Noise) on Reed.co.uk & Seek.com.au via MCP & n8n](https://truonggiang0111.github.io/mcp/direct-employer-hiring-leads-uk-au/): Reed `direct=True` + bootcamp exclusion + Outside/Inside IR35 flags paired with Seek JobSearch v5 JSON + GraphQL `companyProfile` enrichment + daily `n8n` pipeline.
